apps.title: School App-1
apps.description: A nine-module study app for school students: welcome screen, homework, timetable, reminders, quiz, study helper, achievements, library and cyber safety.

apps.title: Student Dismissal App
apps.description: A school app where a student saves their SID, name and grade, then sends a dismissal request with a calendar date, time and reason, and shows a gate slip.
